title: Station Borealis: Containment Protocol
description: An Arctic environmental research outpost suffers a catastrophic geothermal rupture, triggering an automated quarantine lockout. Coordinate between trapped specialists inside and the command station outside to engineer a safe extraction before the storm peaks.

characters.name: Dr. Aris
characters.title: Lead Geothermal Engineer
characters.goal: Stabilize core pressure, override manual safety bypass valves, survive the freeze.

characters.name: Kael
characters.title: Atmospheric Sensor Analyst
characters.goal: Recover sensor logs, map auxiliary ventilation duct routing, prevent asphyxiation.
characters.fear: Toxic gas leakage, succumbing to shock.

characters.name: Commander Vance
characters.title: Outpost Security Chief
characters.goal: Enforce strict quarantine protocol to protect the upper habitat from contamination.

characters.name: Nolan
characters.title: Contract Supply Pilot
characters.goal: Secure valuable salvage/fuel cells and escape on the last transport before the blizzard peaks.
characters.fear: Being stranded in the arctic, losing his cargo.
